plan: Inset 'Gingerah Fort' on 'Plan and view of Gingerah, commonly called Donda Rajapore' (A. Werner; publ. A. Dalrymple, June 1771; BnF Gallica btv1b85931692, via Wikimedia Commons, public domain)
pixel_frame: native crop of the 4288x5592 scan at offset (2610, 3337); x right, y down
method: similarity transform (scale, rotation, translation) from plan pixels to OSM local metres (x east, y north; origin = centroid of the OSM outline way 330556777). Fitted by maximising overlap (IoU) between the plan island silhouette and the OSM outline polygon; no interior feature was used in the fit.
scale_discrepancy: The printed scale bar (1000 ft = 877 px) gives 0.3475 m/px; the outline fit gives 0.265 m/px, a 24% difference. The engraving's island is drawn larger than the bar says. The fit (which agrees with OSM on independent features) is used; the plan is not a reliable metric source beyond +-15 m.
gate_snapping: Plan gate positions are snapped to the nearest point of the OSM wall line (distances recorded in each element's note).
not_traced: about 80 small house blocks; the sea approaches and soundings; plan bastion count is 18 against 19 in the written sources
traced_by: visual reading of crops; bastion centres, gates, mosque and magazine pixel coordinates are in tools/trace/curation/murud-janjira.mjs
